name: Paracetamol 500 mg
description: Commonly used to reduce fever and relieve mild to moderate pain. Follow the label or clinician instructions.
caution: Do not exceed the recommended dose; ask a clinician if you have liver disease or take other medicines containing paracetamol.

name: Cetirizine 10 mg
description: An antihistamine used for symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose and itching.
caution: May cause drowsiness in some people. Follow clinician or package directions.

name: Omeprazole 20 mg
description: Reduces stomach acid and is used for certain reflux and acidity conditions.
caution: Use according to clinician advice, especially for persistent symptoms.

name: Amoxicillin 500 mg
description: A prescription antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections.
caution: Prescription medicine. Do not use for viral illnesses or share antibiotics with others.

name: Salbutamol inhaler
description: A reliever inhaler that can help open narrowed airways in some respiratory conditions.
caution: Use only as directed by a clinician and seek urgent help for severe breathing difficulty.

name: ORS solution
description: Oral rehydration solution helps replace fluids and electrolytes during dehydration from diarrhea or vomiting.
caution: Prepare exactly as directed on the packet.

name: Vitamin D3
description: A vitamin D supplement used when supplementation is recommended.
caution: Dose should be based on clinician advice or product directions.

name: Iron + Folic Acid
description: Supplement commonly prescribed for iron deficiency or during pregnancy when clinically appropriate.
caution: Can cause stomach upset or constipation; use the dose recommended by a clinician.
